messages:
nina_cs: Quick harvest from three onboarding calls this morning — grouping asks + pain points so we can hand to product.

- Customer A (MidMarket SaaS): wants per-route billing visibility in UI + ability to mute non-prod projects.
- Customer B (FinServ pilot): embedding staleness — says vector search returns older docs unless we reindex daily.
- Customer C (PLG): onboarding flow confusing around dedicated capacity opt-in; they expected auto-recommendation.

Link to raw notes: drive/ok-ish-csv (shared). Asking: can product triage into quick wins vs roadmap? :eyes:

leo_pm: Thanks Nina — super helpful. Quick q: for embedding staleness, do we have evidence it's model side vs indexing? any logs or repro steps? Also tagging as potential renewal risk for FinServ.

nina_cs: For B I copied their quote: "search keeps surfacing 3-week-old changelogs even after new uploads". They said they POST new vectors and still see old results until we re-run full index. No bug id yet. I added sample payload they used in the drive.

sam_eng: can you paste the payload here? small repro would help. If it's a client-side issue we should recommend incremental upserts; if it's on our side maybe caching/kv TTL.

nina_cs: pasted sample snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "route": "prod-eu", "docs": ["...new doc..."], "upsert": true }
```
They said search hits unchanged for ~30m until full reindex.

anya_research: embedding freshness sounds like a sell/ops concern. Assign low/med risk? For prioritization matrix: this affects FinServ pilot (high $$$) so treat as P1 for the next sprint planning unless repro fails.

leo_pm: Proposal: triage into three lanes
- Quick wins (1-2 dev days): UI toggle for mute non-prod projects, small onboarding copy tweak for Dedicated opt-in.
- Investigate (sprint): embedding freshness repro + monitoring metric (index-latency, upsert-success-rate).
- Roadmap: per-route billing UX (needs design + data infra)

nina_cs: Agree. Customer A said "we keep getting billed for test routes, hard to reconcile", so UI mute would reduce churn risk. I'll flag finance impact in the ticket.

sam_eng: I'll try to repro embedding freshness tomorrow. If I get a failing repro I'll post a minimal test and tag infra. ETA EOD tomorrow.

leo_pm: Nice. Nina, can you create three GH issues (quick-win, investigate, roadmap) with the customer quotes + sample payloads and link them here? I'll add priority and estimate.

nina_cs: On it — will create and ping. Also suggest a short enablement note for CSMs: recommended messaging for Dedicated opt-in (1-pager) — could be a quick enablement win.

opsbot: Reminder: create_issue command available — use `/create_issue quick-win "mute-nonprod-ui"` to auto-fill metadata. :robot_face:

nina_cs: used the bot to create quick-win issue and attached quotes. dropping the links in GH now. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

leo_pm: Great — once sam confirms repro we can escalate. If anybody hears more from FinServ pilot mark as renewal-watch and ping me.

sam_eng: Repro attempt scheduled. Will post results here.

nina_cs: closing loop for now — will follow up with the enablement note draft by EOB tomorrow.
